info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Payments Payments Status-v1-spec
info.description: The Payments Status API allows developers to retrieve the status of multiple payment transactions efficiently. This endpoint serves as a vital resource for businesses that need to monitor payment processing, providing insights into successful, pending, or failed transactions. Typical consumers of this API include financial institutions, payment processors, and e-commerce platforms seeking to enhance user experiences by providing real-time payment status updates. Leveraging this API can significantly streamline reconciliation processes and improve customer communication related to payment statuses.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to check the current status of payments. Use this to obtain detailed information about the payment processing state and any relevant updates regarding the transaction.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving the status of payments. This body should contain the necessary data to query the payment status.

200.description: Request completed successfully and payment status retrieved.

ListPaymentsPaymentsStatusRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to payment status. It is expected to be a string that may contain various values pertinent to payment status operations.

ListPaymentsPaymentsStatusResponse_200.title: Payment Status Response

status.description: Indicates if the payment status retrieval was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The unique reference number associated with the payment.

resultId.description: The identifier for the result of the payment operation.

state.description: The current state of the payment.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the payment request in milliseconds.

message.description: Additional details or messages regarding the payment status.

ListPaymentsPaymentsStatusResponse_200.description: Schema representing the response for the payment status operation.
